beats: Every feature I ship used to sit on its own lonely page -- no way to browse what else was there.
No topic filter, no project view, and sharing one feature meant sharing a clunky full page reload.
I built one features hub: click a category badge and the whole list filters instantly.
A cached Supabase query backs it, so filtering never re-hits the database.
Now every feature page and the hub itself are crawlable, filterable, and shareable by a direct link.
